prose: UK-based Google DeepMind staff are urging leaders to drop non-disparagement clauses that bar public warnings about AI risks even after employees leave, per the Washington Post. Current workers say the employment contracts deter them from warning the public.
highlights: DeepMind UK staff ask leadership to drop post-employment non-disparagement clauses
Workers say the contracts deter public warnings about AI risks, per WaPo sources
basis: Error cache: WaPo paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and subhead.
